agentFile.description: Full-stack software engineer specializing in production web applications, FastAPI backends, TypeScript/React frontends, cloud deployments, testing, performance optimization, and AI-assisted development

professionalSummary.headline: Full Stack Developer focused on production systems, scalable web applications, and AI-assisted engineering.
professionalSummary.summary: Full Stack Developer with 1 year of professional experience building and maintaining production web and mobile applications used by real users. Experienced across frontend, backend, databases, testing, deployment, and cloud infrastructure, with hands-on work using Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, React Native, Node.js, Express.js, SQL databases, Docker, GitHub Actions, and AWS. Comfortable owning features end-to-end, debugging production issues, improving application performance, and integrating Generative AI and LLM-powered capabilities into application workflows.

aboutMe.name: Jarren James Parungao
aboutMe.title: Full Stack Developer
aboutMe.bio: I am a full-stack developer who enjoys working across the complete software lifecycle, from frontend interfaces and API design to database modeling, testing, deployment, and production support. My professional experience is centered on building systems that are used in real operational environments, including AURORA, a production learning management system and mobile application, and OfficeSales System, an internal sales and e-commerce platform.
aboutMe.engineeringApproach: I focus on practical engineering: understanding the actual problem, keeping solutions maintainable, testing critical behavior, and making changes that can be verified in production. I regularly work on authentication, role-based workflows, high-concurrency backend behavior, database performance, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure.
aboutMe.aiAssistedWorkflow: I use AI-assisted coding tools as part of my daily development workflow to accelerate implementation, investigate bugs, review code and implementation approaches, improve testing, identify edge cases, and reduce issues before they reach production. I treat AI as an engineering multiplier while validating outputs against the codebase, tests, documentation, and real application behavior.

projects.name: AURORA
projects.description: AURORA is a production learning management system and mobile application serving thousands of users across learning, assessment, notification, and account workflows.
highlights: Improved API and database response times by approximately 40% under high-concurrency workloads.
Contributed across frontend, backend, database, testing, deployment, and infrastructure layers of a production system.

projects.name: AURORA Mobile Application
projects.description: AURORA is a production learning management system and mobile application serving thousands of users across learning, assessment, notification, and account workflows.
highlights: Built mobile application features with React Native and Expo while integrating them with FastAPI backend services.
Supported authentication, permissions, assessments, notifications, and other user-facing mobile workflows.

projects.name: Convox
projects.description: Convox is a platform for managing messages and inquiries from students and potential customers through a dashboard, with sales opportunities distributed among employees using a round-robin workflow.
highlights: Makes message management easier through a centralized dashboard for student and potential-customer inquiries.
Distributes sales opportunities across employees using a round-robin workflow to balance workloads and incentives.

projects.name: CaloriJuan
projects.description: CaloriJuan is a personal project that serves as a calorie tracking and meal planning application, allowing users to log their meals, track their caloric intake, and plan their diet effectively.
highlights: Provides precise calorie calculations based on the user's meal inputs.
Allows users to share meals as posts with ingredients, calories, and macronutrients displayed.
Verifies macronutrient data through Open Food Facts and USDA FoodData Central, with AI suggestions based on meal inputs.

projects.name: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory Photobooth AMA
projects.description: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory Photobooth AMA is a web application that allows users to take photos with themed frames and share them on social media, enhancing the event experience for attendees.

images.alt: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory Photobooth AMA application preview
Photobooth successful capture screen with QR retrieval

highlights: Saves user-generated images to AWS S3 for durable digital storage.
Provides QR codes so users can retrieve their images digitally with ease.

projects.name: Karen
projects.description: Karen is a monitoring bot that tracks the status of services on an EC2 instance and sends notifications to a Telegram group when issues arise. It provides commands such as /status and /docker, along with nightly scan reports using AI to summarize service and server status.

images.alt: Karen bot reporting a monitored server startup

highlights: Makes issues on EC2 servers easier to detect through monitoring and Telegram notifications.
Enables server checks and issue management without an SSH connection through Telegram API commands.

projects.name: SnapFrame
projects.description: SnapFrame is an improved, configurable version of the Charlie and the Chocolate Factory Photobooth AMA project. It lets users take photos with reusable themed frames while supporting digital retrieval and sharing.
highlights: Improves on the static CACF Photobooth by allowing backgrounds to change when image dimensions and the transparent window remain consistent.
Generates PDFs with QR codes, saves images to AWS S3, and displays QR-enabled images for easy retrieval.

projects.name: OfficeSales System
projects.description: OfficeSales System is an internal full-stack sales and e-commerce platform supporting product management, inventory, ordering, authentication, and administration workflows.
highlights: Worked on a real internal business application rather than a tutorial or portfolio-only project.
Gained end-to-end experience across frontend, backend, database, authentication, and deployment workflows.
